Related AgreementRead Terms & Conditions
01OVERVIEW & COMMITMENT

1. Overview & Studio Commitment

Welcome to ANSES STUDIOS ("we," "our," or "us"). We are an independent creative entertainment studio producing original cinematic experiences at the frontier of human direction and generative artificial intelligence, including the official series AZANIRA.

We believe exceptional storytelling requires exceptional trust. This Privacy Policy outlines what information we collect when you visit our website (ansesstudios.com), interact with our preview media, subscribe to studio updates, or connect with our official YouTube channels.

02INFORMATION COLLECTION

2. Information We Collect

A. Voluntarily Provided Information

When you contact our studio via email for press inquiries, licensing requests, fan feedback, or production collaborations, we collect your name, email address, and the contents of your message.

B. Technical Diagnostics & Telemetry

To ensure smooth 4K video previews and responsive rendering across desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers, our hosting infrastructure may temporarily process technical data such as browser type, operating system, preferred language, referring URL, and approximate geographic region (country or city level). We do not correlate this information with personally identifiable profiles.

03DATA USAGE

3. How We Use Information

  • Media Delivery: Serving high-definition posters, character art, and video modal streams seamlessly.
  • Communications: Responding promptly to licensing, distribution, press, or viewer inquiries.
  • Site Reliability: Monitoring server health, detecting bot abuse or denial-of-service attempts, and fixing rendering bugs.
  • Zero Commercial Sale: We never sell, rent, or trade viewer information to data brokers or advertising exchanges.
04STREAMING PLAYERS

4. YouTube & Embedded Media Players

The official trailer and teaser videos for AZANIRA are hosted on YouTube and streamed through YouTube's privacy-enhanced embed player.

When you initiate playback through our modal player or follow direct links to our channel (@anses_studios), your interaction is governed by:

YouTube Terms of ServiceGoogle Privacy Policy
05TRANSPARENCY

5. AI Media & Creative Content Integrity

ANSES STUDIOS produces original narrative IP using advanced generative artificial intelligence, neural rendering models, and human cinematic direction.

INTELLECTUAL INTEGRITY & DATA SCRAPING

All characters, keyframes, plotlines, dialogue scripts, and audio masters displayed on this website are original creative works of ANSES STUDIOS. We strictly forbid unauthorized scraping, reverse-engineering, or ingestion of our media into public AI training datasets without explicit contractual license.

06STORAGE & PREFERENCES

6. Cookies & Local Browser Storage

Our website does not use tracking cookies for behavioral targeting or cross-site profiling. We may utilize standard browser localStorage or session state strictly for functional purposes, such as:

  • Remembering volume or modal player state.
  • Cashing visual assets to reduce bandwidth on repeated visits.
  • Preserving UI navigation state.
07USER RIGHTS

7. Your Rights (GDPR & CCPA / CPRA)

Regardless of your location, you have the right to inspect, correct, or request the permanent deletion of any personal communications or contact records we hold.

European Union (GDPR)

Right of access, rectification, data portability, erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"), and objection to processing under EU Regulation 2016/679.

California (CCPA/CPRA)

Right to know, delete, and opt-out of data sales. Note that ANSES STUDIOS does not sell any consumer personal data.

08PROTECTION

8. Children's Privacy

Our digital properties and cinematic showcases are intended for general audiences interested in narrative mystery and cinema. We do not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from children under the age of 13 (or under 16 in applicable European jurisdictions). If we become aware that we have collected information from a child without verified parental consent, we will delete that data immediately.

09CONTACT

9. Studio Legal Inquiries & Contact

If you have questions, feedback, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, our data practices, or intellectual property rights, please reach out to our legal and production coordination team:
